trigger: Walking or sprinting on grass, dirt, stone, snow, wood, sand, or shallow water
sound: Short material-specific step; 3-4 pitch variants per surface
notes: Highest repetition in the game; surface variants matter more than volume.

trigger: Sprint begins; stamina hits exhaustion; recovery
sound: Short exertion cue, tired breath, stamina warning
notes: Keep the loop quiet and duck it under other SFX.

trigger: Global.damage_player applies damage (not blocked by i-frames)
sound: Short pain grunt + impact layer; light/heavy variants
notes: Do not retrigger every frame; use the damage event.

trigger: Death sequence starts
sound: Falling body, equipment clatter, low death sting
notes: Music/BGM is out of scope; this is a short death SFX.

trigger: Respawn at bonfire/world spawn
sound: Soft whoosh + settling step
notes: Avoid a full fanfare; keep it brief.

trigger: Food item consumed
sound: Crunch/chew/sip set
notes: Different food families can share one set.

trigger: Stat crystal consumed
sound: Crystalline chime + healing shimmer
notes: Life and stamina can use pitch/color variants.

trigger: Health below threshold
sound: Muffled heartbeat/breathing loop
notes: Optional; make it duckable and disable in accessibility settings.

trigger: swing_held_item / swing_performed
sound: Airy whoosh; sword, axe, and pickaxe variants
notes: The swing fires frequently; variation prevents fatigue.

trigger: Sword hitbox hits mob, block, tree, or grass
sound: Flesh, wood, stone, soft-earth impact layers
notes: Layer with the swing; do not replace it.

trigger: placeable_block._break or cave _break_tile
sound: Wood, stone, soft earth, ore break set
notes: One break cue per material family, 3 variants each.

trigger: world.place_block_at or robot placement
sound: Wood, stone, soft earth placement thud
notes: Robot placement can use a quieter servo-layered variant.

trigger: tree.gd takes chop damage; final chop frees the tree
sound: Wood crack, creak, fall, ground impact
notes: Fall cue should be longer but not boomy.

trigger: world._cut_grass_row / sword grass cut
sound: Sharp swish + soft foliage rustle
notes: Can share the swing layer but needs a leafy tail.

trigger: Player moves through a grass tuft
sound: Soft brush/rustle
notes: Throttle it; do not play on every frame.

trigger: Hoe use, seed placement, bucket pour, crop harvest
sound: Soil scrape, seed drop, water pour, plant pull
notes: One set per action; crops can share the harvest sound.

trigger: Global.block_mode changes
sound: Short UI/mechanical toggle
notes: Quiet; this is a mode switch.

trigger: Ghost turns red / placement rejected
sound: Dull denial buzz or click
notes: Do not use the same sound as a successful place.

trigger: add_item / deposit_item fails
sound: Low error thunk
notes: Distinct from generic UI error.

trigger: Drop enters inventory or hotbar
sound: Short bright pickup blip; stack-size variants
notes: Do not play one cue per item in a large stack.

trigger: Player or robot drops an item
sound: Soft item drop/land
notes: Material variants optional.

trigger: Inventory UI opens or closes
sound: Panel slide + soft click
notes: Keep short; menus are frequent.

trigger: Hotbar slot changes
sound: Short tick/click
notes: Pitch up/down for next/previous is optional.

trigger: Drag item between slots; split stack; trash
sound: Soft pick/place click, trash crumple
notes: Do not confuse with world pickup.

trigger: Chest UI opens/closes; rare chest found
sound: Wood latch, lid creak, close thud; rare chest sparkle
notes: Rare chest needs a distinct reward flourish.

trigger: Placeable door toggles
sound: Latch click + wood swing/close
notes: Use material variants for birch/snowy doors if cheap.

trigger: Bonfire plain-click sets or clears respawn
sound: Whoosh, crackle burst, soft extinguish
notes: Active vs inactive state should be audibly distinct.

trigger: Torch placed or mined
sound: Soft plant/light pop; remove puff
notes: Optional quiet flame loop under ambience.

trigger: Rod cast; fish bites; reel starts; catch/miss resolves
sound: Cast whoosh, splash, line tick, reel, catch jingle, miss plop
notes: The bite should be the clearest cue; player reaction depends on it.

trigger: Map opens/closes; waypoint selected; travel starts/arrives
sound: Map unfold, marker click, charge hum, teleport whoosh, arrival settle
notes: Waypoint charge should communicate the delay before travel.

trigger: Enter/exit water; fill/empty bucket; pour water
sound: Splash, wade, bucket fill, pour
notes: Throttle wading; bucket fill/pour are distinct one-shots.

trigger: Any menu interaction
sound: Pixel click/blip, back, tab, toggle, slider tick; 2-3 variants each
notes: Click/back are P0; hover/slider are polish.

trigger: Action succeeds, fails, or toast appears
sound: Success chime, error buzz, info/success/warn toast
notes: Keep the same language across all menus.

trigger: Main menu, pause menu, settings, inventory
sound: Panel open/close, pause stop/resume
notes: Pause should be short and non-musical.

trigger: Save slot saved, loaded, deleted, or errors
sound: Confirm click, save stamp, load whoosh, delete warning
notes: Delete should require a clearly different confirmation tone.

trigger: Account form submit; cloud sync starts, succeeds, conflicts, fails
sound: Auth success/fail; sync spinner ticks, success, conflict, error
notes: Conflict/error cues must not be confused with gameplay damage.

trigger: Leaderboard loads; mission reward claimed
sound: Refresh tick, star claim chime
notes: Star claim can share the star-earned cue.

trigger: add_mission_progress; complete_mission; mission_star_earned
sound: Progress tick, completion flourish, star sparkle
notes: Mission completion is a core reward moment.

trigger: Knowledge entry learned; bestiary entry discovered
sound: Page shimmer, archive stamp, creature reveal
notes: Separate archive vs creature identity.

trigger: Tutorial opens, advances, finishes, or is skipped
sound: Dialogue open, text advance, success, skip
notes: Do not use the same sound as generic menu click.

trigger: Lua/Python editor opens; RUN/STOP; program succeeds/fails
sound: Panel open, run start, terminal tick, success chime, error buzz, stop
notes: Typing sounds are optional P2; errors must feel distinct.

trigger: Quiz altar opens; answer submitted; hint; code run; results
sound: Panel open, correct, wrong, hint, run, completion
notes: Wrong answer should be clear but not harsh.

trigger: Altar opens; page turns; entry unlocks
sound: Stone open, page turn, unlock shimmer
notes: Can reuse knowledge unlock with altar-specific layer.

trigger: Color wheel changes; colored block crafted
sound: Color tick, hue chime, craft pop
notes: Pitch can follow the selected hue for feedback.

trigger: Crafting station UI opens/closes
sound: Wood/metal panel open, close latch
notes: Station identity: workshop, not generic menu.

trigger: Recipe list selection changes
sound: Soft page/click tick
notes: Quiet; selection can be rapid.

trigger: craft() / craft_request starts, finishes, or fails
sound: Work start, hammer/craft completion, error buzz
notes: Completion is P0; start/fail are P1.

trigger: Input slot loaded; output taken
sound: Item drop into slot; output pickup/chime
notes: Give output collection a small reward feel.

action: Furnace open/close, feed, fuel, smelt, fail
trigger: Furnace UI opens; feed/fuel; smelt starts/tick/completes/fails
sound: Lid, ore drop, fuel whoosh, fire loop, metal clink, error
notes: Smelt loop must be quiet and duckable under UI.

trigger: LUA station placed; editor opens/closes
sound: Robot boot chirp, panel open, panel close
notes: The station is a robot; give it a servo/terminal identity.

trigger: Run pressed; program executes; error; STOP
sound: Terminal run, success beep, error buzz, stop clunk
notes: Match the algorithmica run language but keep robot/terminal timbre.

trigger: Robot is moving or hovering
sound: Soft servo loop or periodic hover tick
notes: Loop only while moving; avoid constant whine.

trigger: Robot performs chop, mine, or placement
sound: Servo + wood/stone impact; build placement
notes: Reuse world impact layers with a robot servo transient.

trigger: Robot swings, takes damage, dies/terminates
sound: Metal swing, hit, damage clank, shutdown
notes: Combat robots need a distinct shutdown cue.

trigger: Robot deposits to chest, withdraws, or returns to station
sound: Item transfer ticks, servo turn, docking clunk
notes: Low priority but useful for long automation sessions.

trigger: No tool equipped; invalid target; no chest/space
sound: Robot error chirp + UI error
notes: Must be distinct from player inventory error.

trigger: Python program runs, succeeds, fails, or uses a foreign API
sound: Terminal run, success chime, error buzz, rejection buzz
notes: Station/furnace should share the same Algorithmica identity.

trigger: craft_color() succeeds or fails
sound: Hue pop/chime; low cactus error
notes: Could reuse color crafter cue with a machine layer.

trigger: Wolf idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: growl, bite snap, yelp, death whine
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Pixie idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: glassy chime, dart, cry, death sparkle
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Desert Worm idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: burrow rumble, emerge, lunge, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Headless Fish idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: wing flap, bite, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Sheep idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: bleat, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Hitman idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: heavy footstep, roar, slam, projectile, hurt, defeat
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Rune Sentinel idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: stone grind, slam, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Brass Prowler idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: mechanical skitter, swipe, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Cinder Ooze idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: bubble, spit, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Cipher Warden idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: digital hum, cast, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Gravebell Shambler idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: bell rattle, swipe, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Emberfox Kit idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: chirp, pounce, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Mossback Nib idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: nibble, charge, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Vesper Acolyte idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: chant, cast, hurt, death
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: Wisp companion idle/ambient, attack, hurt, and death
sound: soft chime, follow loop, hurt, fade
notes: One distinct identity per mob; do not reuse the player hit sound as the death cue.

trigger: A mob appears in view or is recycled off-screen
sound: Soft spatial pop/whoosh; avoid off-screen churn
notes: Do not play for ambient spawns outside the camera.

trigger: Hitman fires, slams, or self-destructs
sound: Projectile launch, impact, heavy slam, explosion
notes: Self-destruct must be heard over other combat.

trigger: Flare fires; projectile flies/impacts; trap steps; explosion
sound: Vent whoosh, bolt launch, sizzle, click, blast
notes: Trap click is a warning; explosion is P0.

trigger: Sword parries a bolt; safe zone activates or pulses
sound: Metal ting, safe-zone hum, ward pulse
notes: Parry should be crisp; safe-zone hum is optional ambience.

trigger: Cave portal confirms; player enters or leaves cave
sound: Stone slide, echo, distant drip, exit gust
notes: Cave transition should feel like a space change, not a menu.

trigger: Player nears a cave mouth; confirms entry
sound: Low rumble, highlight ping, confirm click
notes: Keep the highlight subtle; confirm is the important cue.

trigger: Dungeon portal activates, entered, or exited
sound: Rune hum, portal whoosh, arrival thud
notes: Dungeons should sound different from caves.

trigger: Dungeon cleared; 1/2/3-star result
sound: Clear fanfare, star chime, perfect-clear shimmer
notes: This is the main reward moment; no BGM needed, just a strong SFX.

trigger: Tower activated; travel charge; arrival
sound: Crystal chime, charge loop, teleport whoosh, arrival
notes: Charge sound communicates the cast delay.

trigger: Temporary waypoint appears; activated
sound: Rune spawn, activation ping
notes: Could share world waypoint family with a darker layer.

trigger: Dawn or dusk changes the world state
sound: Soft wind/chime transition
notes: Not BGM; a short environmental sting.

trigger: Snowstorm begins or ends
sound: Wind rise, wind fade, snow crunch layer
notes: Weather layer; ensure it ducks under combat.

trigger: Day/night ambient birds appear
sound: Finch/kite chirp variants
notes: Non-BGM ambience; spatial one-shots.

trigger: Player is inside a cave
sound: Drips, low echo, distant stone settles
notes: Non-BGM bed; loop seamlessly.

trigger: Player is inside a dungeon
sound: Low rune hum, torch crackle, distant stone
notes: Non-BGM bed; layer with portal/fire SFX.

trigger: Player near lit torch/bonfire
sound: Small flame crackle loop
notes: Spatial loop; fade with distance.

trigger: Exposed overworld, snowy biome, storm
sound: Soft wind loop; snowstorm variant
notes: Keep under BGM and other ambience.
